summary: Afya Limited filed a Form 6-K on September 18, 2026, announcing a routine regulatory authorization rather than a special situation. Brazil's Ministry of Education (MEC) granted an increase of 17 medical seats at ITPAC Cruzeiro do Sul (AFYA Cruzeiro do Sul) in Cruzeiro do Sul, Acre. The campus now holds 67 authorized seats, bringing Afya's total approved medical seats to 3,785. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. This is an operational/regulatory development, not an M&A, activist, tender, or capital-structure event; watch for enrollment and revenue implications only.
